command:
set +e
sed -n '11,309p' docs/dev/debt/libSceLibcInternal.md | grep -oE '^\| `[^`]+` \| `[^`]+`' | sed -E 's/^\| `([^`]+)` \| `([^`]+)`/\1 \2/' > /tmp/names.txt
wc -l /tmp/names.txt
while read name nid; do
  hit=$(grep -rn -F "${name}_nid_postfix(" core/libs/prx/libc/include core/libs/prx/libc/*.hpp 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$hit" ]; then echo "HAVE $name $nid :: $hit"; fi
done < /tmp/names.txt
echo "== test file"; cat core/libs/tests/GuestLibcInternalAlignedNew.cpp
echo "== how tests registered"; grep -rn "GuestLibcInternalAlignedNew" --include=CMakeLists.txt --include=*.cmake . | head
